components.name: Primary Unlock Button
components.description: Main action button to decrypt and unlock PDF file.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6366f1; color: #ffffff; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; border: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; width: 100%; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4f46e5; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3); }

components.name: Dropzone Container
components.description: Drag and drop area for uploading PDF documents.
components.html:
Click or drag & drop a PDF here
Maximum file size depends on your device's memory
components.css: .ds-dropzone { border: 2px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 3rem 1.5rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.3); } .ds-dropzone:hover { border-color: #6366f1; background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.05); } .ds-dropzone-icon { color: #6366f1; } .ds-dropzone-text { font-weight: 500; color: #f8fafc; } .ds-dropzone-subtext { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #94a3b8; }

components.name: Password Input
components.description: Secure input field for entering the PDF password.
components.css: .ds-input-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; width: 100%; text-align: left; } .ds-input-group label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #94a3b8; } .ds-password-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.875rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8); color: #f8fafc; font-size: 1rem; outline: none; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-password-input:focus { border-color: #6366f1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2); }

narrative.overview: PDF Password Unlocker is designed as a dark, high-clarity slate workspace with translucent glass panels, crisp typography, and glowing indigo focus states.
keyCharacteristics: Dark slate background with subtle radial gradient depth
Glassmorphic container cards with 12px backdrop blur
High-contrast typography with indigo-tinted gradient display headers

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Electric Indigo is reserved strictly for primary actions, active focus states, and key state transitions.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Typography uses fixed rem sizing rather than fluid clamp() functions to preserve tool density.

rules.name: The Tonal Glass Rule
rules.body: Card surfaces rely on 12px backdrop blur and 1px translucent borders to establish hierarchy.

dos: Do maintain a strict 4.5:1 minimum text contrast ratio against dark backgrounds.
Do use native inline feedback alerts for decryption errors instead of intrusive popups.
Do keep the file unlock flow restricted to a single screen without multi-step wizard pagination.
donts: Don't use generic white SaaS backgrounds with light blue accent buttons.
Don't introduce multi-colored card borders or side-stripe accents.
Don't open popups or modal overlays for simple file operations or password prompts.
